ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Shootings Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail behind the Minnesota shootings and determine if there are any links to larger financial or political interests.
questions: What are the financial ties between the Trump administration and the agents involved in the shootings?
Are there any larger financial or political interests at play?
ideas.insight: This investigation could uncover a larger pattern of corruption or misconduct, and following the money trail may lead to unexpected discoveries.
